title: Dental PPO Plans Enrollment Eligibility and Coverage Effective Dates
content:
**Who may be enrolled.** An enrollment in the Dental PPO Plans may be opened only for a plan whose entry gate admits the market segment (the Elite plan is sold to employer groups only, and only exchange-filed plans may be sold on the individual exchange), and, for a group enrollment, only when the sponsoring group contract is active (as shown on the group contract record). A child may be enrolled only if the child has not reached the dependent child age limit birthday on the coverage effective date.

**Coverage effective date.**

| Enrollment | Coverage effective date |
|---|---|
| Individual or individual exchange, application received on or before the 15th day of a month | The first day of the following month |
| Individual or individual exchange, application received after the 15th day of a month | The first day of the second following month |
| Group, open enrollment | The group's open-enrollment effective date |
| Group, new hire | The first of the month after the new hire completes the group's eligibility waiting period |
| Group, special enrollment | The first of the month after a special enrollment request made within the special enrollment window (or the longer window after loss of Medicaid or CHIP) |
| Group, anyone else (late entrant) | The first of the month after the request |

The cutoff day for individual applications is the 15th of the month: an application received on the 15th takes effect on the first of the following month, and one received on the 16th on the first of the second following month.

**Prior coverage.** Prior coverage is recorded as prior coverage months and a prior coverage end date only when documented by a certificate of coverage, and only when it ended no more than the plan's maximum prior-coverage gap before the coverage effective date; otherwise the prior coverage months are 0.

**Re-enrollment lockout (time condition).** A person whose individual-market dental enrollment ended by voluntary termination may not be enrolled in an individual-market plan until the re-enrollment lockout has run from the voluntary termination of the person's previous individual-market enrollment.
- The clock starts from the termination date of that previous enrollment, as shown on the enrollment record.
- The lockout is counted in calendar months from that termination date; when the target day does not exist in the end month, the last day of that month is used.
- The new application date may fall on or after the resulting date; the resulting date itself satisfies the lockout.
- The lockout does not apply to group enrollments, to terminations for nonpayment (which follow the reinstatement and binder rules instead) or to enrollments cancelled in the free-look period.

### Lockout boundary cases (hypothetical, 12-month lockout)
| Voluntary termination date | Lockout end date | Application dated | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| 31 March of one year | 31 March of the next year | 31 March of the next year | Satisfies the lockout |
| 31 March of one year | 31 March of the next year | 30 March of the next year | Within the lockout |
| 29 February of a leap year | 28 February of the next year (no 29th exists in that month) | 28 February of the next year | Satisfies the lockout |
